Name: Escape from Joja
Author: padawanjedi
Description:
You left Joja, but did Joja leave you?  Of course not.  Joja understands that sometimes circumstances change, former Joja executive, and you are owed your severance pay.  This mod will send you your outstanding shares, which you can sell for immediate cash at standard value (either at certain merchants or through the shipping bin).  We at Joja Corp. hope that this helps make your new life a little easier.  With love from all your former coworkers and superiors at Joja.  We wish you the best.  Thrive!

You can now select a severance package that matches your previous role at Joja: Support Manager, R&D Executive, Interim Director, or Junior VP.  (Or all of them.  I can't stop you, but your mailbox will look ridiculous.)  Joja's stock price matches that of another very large shopping conglomerate.  Thrive!

[I can't get STF to behave with all my other mods, so I fell back on giving the certificates a type that would allow them to be sold over the counter.]

Requires Mail Framework Mod and Json Assets.

Downloads.Description: Default release.  For the R&D Executive, 50 shares of Joja stock.
